coverage: Reported business segments · gross segment income
incomeDefinition: Reported gross segment income includes internal sales and allocated other income. It is before internal eliminations and is not external-customer product sales.
definition: Reported segment result including net movements in regulatory deferral account balances, before unallocated corporate expenses, finance charges, share of equity-accounted joint-venture profits and tax. It is not profit after tax.
location: PDF pages 239–240 · printed pages 475–477 · Note 67, consolidated operating segments
notes: Gross segment income includes allocated other income. Row sum ₹202,026.34 crore less ₹12,884.28 crore intersegment eliminations plus ₹656.50 crore unallocated income gives ₹189,798.56 crore consolidated total income. Segment results total ₹41,671.48 crore; corporate costs, finance, joint-venture profit, tax and regulatory-deferral tax adjustments reconcile to ₹27,545.76 crore group PAT. Generation includes earlier-year sales adjustments. Others combines consultancy, project management, energy trading, oil/gas exploration and coal mining; it is not a pure renewable-energy row.
insight: Generation accounts for most reported segment income and earnings. The table does not isolate coal-versus-renewable profit. Earlier-year tariff adjustments and regulatory accounts also influence reported results.
revenueTotalLabel: Gross segment income before internal eliminations
